I’m Russian. I came to India. And I need to say something about Blinkit.. In Russia we have Yandex Lavka, Samokat, all these delivery apps. And compared to India they’ve completely lost their minds. Free delivery only in the morning, only with some weird conditions, surge pricing every five minutes, “high demand”, “weather conditions”, “courier unavailable”, blah blah blah.

Meanwhile Blinkit in India:
free delivery half the time,
cheap as hell,
and FAST.

Me and my bro ordered a ridiculous amount of food and random stuff for like 1500 rubles total. Enough for a WEEK. In Russia that money gets you depression and maybe two energy drinks.

And the speed? Indian couriers DO NOT SLEEP. I swear this country runs on shift rotations like a sci-fi factory. One guy sleeps at 6 PM and wakes up at 3 AM, another sleeps at 2 AM and wakes up at 10. Delivery never stops. Day, night, apocalypse doesn’t matter.

And somehow there’s STILL no night surcharge.
Meanwhile Yandex be like:
“high demand 🤓”

So if you’re in India giving Blinkit less than 5 stars you are spoiled beyond belief. Go live in Russia for a month and then come back. You’ll start kissing the courier when he arrives in 8 minutes.

When I tried to report the problem, the app did not provide a proper return or replacement option, which is extremely frustrating for customers.
Customer support was slow and unhelpful, repeatedly asking for details but not offering any clear resolution. It feels like there is no accountability once the order is delivered. For a platform that promotes convenience, this kind of service is unacceptable.
Overall, Blinkit needs to seriously improve its quality control, customer support, and return policies. Until then, I would not recommend using this service, as it leads to a waste of both time and money.”

Blocked without Explanation. I am currently visiting India from the US and had been using Blinkit with my Indian number. I successfully placed a few orders recently and was quite pleased with the app and service.

However, during my most recent attempt to place an order it was suddenly cancelled, and I started receiving a message stating “User ID/Device ID blocked.” There was no explanation or prior warning, which is both confusing and frustrating.

I understand that some transactions may have initially failed due to my US credit cards being blocked temporarily by my bank’s fraud protection system. However, every order I placed was eventually paid for successfully.

Blocking my account without any communication or opportunity to resolve the issue is incredibly disappointing especially for a customer who was actively using and recommending your service.

While I genuinely prefer Blinkit’s interface and user experience over competitors, I was forced to switch to Zepto to complete my order. Unfortunately, given this lack of transparency and abrupt service disruption, I will continue using Zepto moving forward unless this situation is addressed appropriately.
